stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Muir Island, Amelia runs tests for the virus Beast designs with Warlock's help, then flees the Phalanx with them. She helps the strike team reach the core, where Warlock carries the virus in.
stages.whoA: The Phalanx heir whose virus she helps finish
stages.whoB: Amelia, the Muir Island resident on his strike team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At Sid's Grill, Pietro doubts Beast's story until Warlock assimilates a fork to prove it. Then his Lifemate, in the Phalanx's grip, attacks the diner, and the Phalanx soon takes Pietro.
stages.whoA: The alien who proves the Phalanx threat to him
stages.whoB: Pietro, the doubter he wins over at the diner

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock knows Hodge as the human who abducted his Lifemate, and Hodge boasts of being the Phalanx guide on Earth. Warlock then carries the virus into the core and purges the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: The runaway heir whose virus purges the Phalanx
stages.whoB: Hodge, the Phalanx guide who took his Lifemate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge serves as development adviser to the Leader's slaving regime and briefs Gyrich on the rebel Cable. When Cable stops their getaway car, the Leader orders Hodge to blast him before the flood hits.
stages.whoA: The Leader whose slaving regime he advises
stages.whoB: Hodge, his adviser who flees the flood with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Justine lets Logan into her hideout, where Sawyer briefs him on freeing Andre Cocteau from the Chateau du Mort. Together they send Logan off, and Justine reveals that Cocteau is her father.
stages.whoA: Justine, whose hideout hosts his briefing
stages.whoB: The Allied captain who briefs Logan in her hideout

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sam refuses to leave his pa in a mine cave in and blasts them both free. Ed urges his boy toward a better life, then stands up for him when the town turns on the Guthries.
stages.whoA: Sam, his son who blasts him out of the mine
stages.whoB: Pa, the miner he refuses to leave behind

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ellen frets over her son and his father working the mines and tells Sam to think about his future. When the town drives the Guthries out, she packs up to leave with him.
stages.whoA: Sam, the son she wants out of the mines
stages.whoB: Ma, who pushes him to look past the mines

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kirkland visits the Guthries and presses Sam to join a government program like a Peace Corps for mutants. Once he has Sam, he calls Xavier and Beast terrorists, but Sam sees the trick, escapes and warns his family.
stages.whoA: The boy he wants for his living weapons program
stages.whoB: Kirkland, the recruiter who tries to use him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: James tends Rebecca as the family physician of Grey Hall and marvels at her sudden recovery. Rebecca then lets slip that Nathaniel has been giving her secret treatments.
stages.whoA: Rebecca, the ailing patient he cannot cure

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: James frees the mutants Essex holds at Grey Hall and finds the frightened Flannery hiding from a mob. He calms him and tells the crowd Flannery is no demon but a man born different.
stages.whoA: Flannery, the frightened mutant he shields
stages.whoB: James, the doctor who frees him and defends him
